subject: Q4 Strategic Coverage Additions — Comp Bands & Offer Caps
messages:
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 strategic coverage hires — request + comps

Jonas / Marissa —

Quick summary: with the new EMEA expansion in mid-November and two enterprise renewals we expect to close in Q4, I’m requesting approval to add 4 net-new GTM heads this quarter to prevent coverage shortfalls. The roles and recommended comp bands are attached (q4_gomarket_comp_bands_v3.pdf) and summarized below.

Why now: pipeline coverage gap analysis (attached model) shows a projected 18% drop in quota attainment if we do not add at least two AEs and one SE by the end of Nov. We also have a strategic account at risk that requires a dedicated CSM to secure renewal.

Requested hires (headcount = net new):
- 2 x AE (quota-carrying) — band: $110k–$155k OTE; target offer $135k OTE
- 1 x Senior Solutions Engineer — band: $150k–$220k OTE; target offer $190k OTE
- 1 x Customer Success Manager (strategic accounts) — band: $95k–$140k OTE; target offer $120k OTE

Proposed ramp timing: hires start late Oct/early Nov -> fully productive mid-Q1.

Request: approval to extend offers up to the listed target offer amounts and headcount authorization to convert two open contractor roles into full-time AE slots (details in headcount_impact_model.xlsx). If we need to reallocate, I can shift one AE to a lower market band to keep FY spend neutral.

Attachments: q4_gomarket_comp_bands_v3.pdf, headcount_impact_model.xlsx, candidate_pipeline-summary.csv

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of Growth — GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 strategic coverage hires — request + comps

On Mon, Oct 15, 2028 at 9:12 AM laura_bennett@redwood.com wrote:
> Jonas / Marissa —
> 
> Quick summary: with the new EMEA expansion in mid-November and two enterprise renewals we expect to close in Q4, I’m requesting approval to add 4 net-new GTM heads this quarter to prevent coverage shortfalls. ...

Thanks Laura — appreciate the concise ask and the model. A couple questions before I can sign off:

1) Net-new headcount vs reclassification: the note says two contractors to convert. Confirm that the $0.0 base budget delta in FY is after contractor conversion. If not, show the incremental ARR / payback timeline.

2) Comp bands look reasonable but the AE target is slightly above current published OTE for the west coast. Can we tighten the AE target to $130k OTE and reserve $5k discretionary signing for hot candidates? That keeps comp governance intact.

3) Need explicit cost-approval from Finance for backfilled contractor spend — request Finance tickets (HRJIRA-1429) linked.

If Marissa confirms the headcount source (new allotment vs reclass), I’m happy to approve at $130k AE target and the SE/CSM bands as proposed, pending Finance confirmation.

—Jonas
VP, Revenue Operations
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 strategic coverage hires — request + comps

On Mon, Oct 15, 2028 at 11:03 AM jonas_weber@redwood.com wrote:
> Thanks Laura — appreciate the concise ask and the model. A couple questions before I can sign off: ...

Jonas — confirming the contractor conversion: we have two open contingent roles budgeted in the ops bucket. Converting those to FTEs requires headcount approval but does not increase FY24 planned spend materially because contingent dollars were already in pipeline. I attached a headcount snapshot in the Drive link.

Operational notes:
- I'll file the formal HR approval ticket (HRJIRA-1429) today and tag Finance.
- For AE offer guidance, People Ops recommends using the $130k OTE target for west coast candidates; allow $7k signing discretionary for exceptional profiles (to be pre-approved by Ben).
- For the SE, the band is market-competitive; we should reserve the top of band for ex-enterprise hires.

Next steps: Jonas to sign off on the AE cap ($130k OTE). Ben to confirm final discretionary signing authority. If both OK, I will publish offer templates and start extending offers to the current finalists (pipeline attached).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, People Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Oct 2028 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 strategic coverage hires — request + comps

On Mon, Oct 15, 2028 at 1:28 PM marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Jonas — confirming the contractor conversion: we have two open contingent roles budgeted in the ops bucket. ...

Approve subject to Finance tagging and the AE cap adjustment. I sign off for up to $7k signing discretionary per AE for exceptional candidates, to be logged in Workday offer notes. For the Senior SE, I want a short calibration call with Laura — 30 minutes — to confirm role scope (pre-sales vs solution architecture).

If we can accelerate these offers this week, we should be able to capture the two candidates who have verbal interest. Please proceed once HRJIRA-1429 is logged and Finance confirms.

Ben Carter
Chief Revenue Officer
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: candidate_pipeline-summary.csv

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, talent+ops@ringway.co, ellen@agencybridge.com
Date: Wed, 17 Oct 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 strategic coverage hires — request + comps

Thanks team — noted and actionable.

Plan of record after threads:
- AE target set to $130k OTE; discretionary signing up to $7k (to be recorded).
- SE target remains $190k OTE; Laura and Ben will have a 30-minute calibration call today at 11:00 PT to confirm scope.
- CSM target unchanged.
- Marissa will open HRJIRA-1429 and tag Finance; Jonas will provide sign-off once Finance confirms contractor conversion costing.
- I’ll instruct Ringway (talent+ops@ringway.co) and AgencyBridge (ellen@agencybridge.com) to prepare offer letters consistent with the updated caps and to push acceptances by EOD Friday.

If there are any objections reply-all; otherwise I’ll proceed with offer extensions.

Best —
Laura
Head of Growth — GTM Operations
laura_bennett@redwood.com
